title: Relatively flat tensor comparison for identified data in a cartesian square
statement: Let f:X→S be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, p:T→S any morphism, and let g:X′→X and f′:X′→T form a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change]. Let E in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and G a bounded-above complex of quasi-coherent modules flat over S [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Given E′ on X′ with Lg*E≅E′ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and a complex G′ with degreewise isomorphisms from ordinary g*G commuting with differentials [def-pc-module-pullback], there is an isomorphism Lp*Rf*(E tensor^L G) ≅ Rf′*(E′ tensor^L G′) [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. This makes no Noetherian, perfectness, proper-support, or finite-presentation assertion.

source.place: Lemma 36.26.4, cartesian square and displayed tensor comparison

proof.text: Apply relativelyFlat_tensor_baseChange_iso to f,p,E,G for the canonical pullback square, using precisely the stated bounded-above, quasi-coherent and relatively flat hypotheses.

Let i be sq.isoPullback from X′ to the canonical pullback. The derived pullback composition and identity comparisons for i and its inverse exhibit Li* as an equivalence. The derived pullback/direct-image adjunction therefore has invertible unit. Map that unit by the direct image of the canonical second projection, then compose with derivedDirectImageComposition, to replace the canonical right-hand side by direct image along i followed by that second projection.

The ordinary tensor-pullback composition and identity comparisons likewise exhibit i* as an equivalence of module categories, hence an exact functor. Extract the left-derived counit from exists_derivedPullback; its object and map formulas identify its underived functor with i*. Mathlib isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts makes the exact mapDerivedCategory another left-derived functor of the same homotopy functor. leftDerivedUnique followed by mapDerivedCategoryFactors identifies Li*(Q(C)) with Q(i*C) for every complex C. In particular C is the ordinary pullback of G along the canonical first projection; no structure-sheaf flatness of G is assumed.

Use the tensorator of exists_derivedPullbackMonoidalModel to distribute Li* over the two tensor factors. On the first factor apply the derived composition comparison. On the second apply the preceding exact computation and mapHomologicalComplexCompIso for the ordinary tensor-pullback composition comparison. Rewrite the two composites with i using isoPullback_hom_fst and isoPullback_hom_snd. This produces the direct image along f′ of Lg*E tensor Q(g*G).

Use HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents with the degreewise isomorphisms e and the symmetric differential equation he to obtain g*G ≅ G′. Map it by Q, tensor with the supplied Lg*E ≅ E′, map by the direct-image functor along f′, and compose all the isomorphisms. These categorical constructions also apply to zero complexes and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Displayed cartesian-square tensor comparison; scheme-isomorphism transport and complex-isomorphism glue implemented in Lean by S3 using the recorded composition, adjunction and monoidal comparisons

theorem cartesian_tensor_data_comparison
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S X' T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (p : T ⟶ S) (g : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T) (sq : IsPullback g f' f p)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E)
    (G : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hGb : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hGqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hGflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFlatOver f)
    (E' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (hEE' : Nonempty ((derivedPullback g).obj E ≅ E'))
    (G' : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℤ)
    (e : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj g (G.X n) ≅ G'.X n)
    (he : ∀ n m : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackMap g (G.d n m) ≫ (e m).hom =
      (e n).hom ≫ G'.d n m) :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback p).obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj (E' ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G'))
